paite: Huan Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite tung ah, Israelte tung ah kumpipa dia nang sathau hon nilh dia ahon sawl ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia in.
heading: Amalek Mite Toh Kidouna
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of Yahweh’s words.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, Amalek mite'n Israelte tung a athilhih uh, Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai ua lampi a ana daldan ka theigige hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

paite: Amalekte dou ding in kuan inla, athil neih tengteng uh hawi himhim nei lou in hihmang vek in. Numei leh pasal, naungek leh nawi ne lai, bawngtal leh belam, sangawngsau leh sabiltung tan in that vek in, achi,” achi hi.
english: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

paite: Huchi in Saul in mipite asamkhawm a, Telaim ah amaute asim a, sepaih nuainih leh Judah mi singkhat ahi uh.
english: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

paite: Saul Amalekte khua atungsuk a, phaizang ah ana buk hi.
english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

paite: Saul in Kente kiang ah, "Hong pawt unla, Amalekte a pan kihuikhia un. Huchi lou in zaw, ka hon that tel kha ding. Nou zaw Israel suan tengteng Aigupta a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai un na na hehpih ua," achi hi. Huchi in Kente Amalek mite lak a pan apawtkhia uhi.
english: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

paite: Saul in Amalek mite Havilah a pan Aigupta gam gei a Shur tan in adou hi.
english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

paite: Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ahingmat a, mipi tengteng namsau in asatlum vek hi.
english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

paite: Himahleh Saul leh mipite'n Agag ahawi ua, belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih, athauthau, belamnoute, ahoih tengteng athat nuam kei uh. Ahoih lou leh adeih louh peuhmah uh bel athat vek uhi.
english: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

paite: TOUPA thu Samuel kiang ah ahong tung hi,
heading: Saul Kumpipa Ahihna Nial Ahi
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Samuel, saying,

paite: "Saul kumpipa dia ka seh ka kisik hi. Hon zui lai hon kinungngatsan in ka thupiak bang in ahih ngal kei a," achi hi. Hiai in Samuel ahehsak a, zankhua in TOUPA asam hi.
english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.

paite: Saul mu ding in Samuel zingkhangpi in athou a, Karmel ah Saul ahoh hi. Ngai in, huai ah amah theihgigena suang aphut a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Gilgal ah apaisukta, chih Samuel hilh in a-om hi.
english: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”

paite: Saul kiang Samuel ahong tung a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. TOUPA thupiak bang in ka hihta," achi hi.
english: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by Yahweh! I have performed the commandment of Yahweh.”

paite: Samuel in, "Tua belam ham ka bil a hong lut leh bawng ham ka zakte bangchidan ahi dia le?" achi hi.
english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

paite: Saul in, "Amalek mite ahon laksak uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in mipite'n belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih ahawi uhi. Adang tengteng ahihleh ka that vek uhi," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Dai in, TOUPA'N tuzan a ka kiang a athugen ka hon hilh ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Gen dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

paite: Samuel in, "Nang ngaih in mi neuchik himah lechin leng, Israel nam heutu dia bawl na hi kei maw? TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in sathau ahon nilh hi.
english: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? Yahweh anointed you king over Israel;

paite: TOUPA'N nang ahon sawlkhia a, kuan inla, mikhialte, Amalek mite that vek inla, amanthat sipsip masiah uh dou zel in, ahon chi hi.
english: and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’

paite: Bang ding a TOUPA thu zui lou a, gallak thilte aboh a na boh a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih mawk?" achi hi.
english: Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”

paite: Saul in Samuel kiang ah, "E, TOUPA thu ka zui vo oi, TOUPA'N hon sawlna ah ka hoh a, Amalek kumpipa Agag ka hon man a, Amalek mite ka that vek vo oi.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed Yahweh’s voice, and have gone the way which Yahweh sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

paite: Himahleh mipite'n gallak thil belam leh bawngtal hihman ding lak ah ahoihhoih Gilgal a TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in ahon tawi uh," achi hi.
english: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God in Gilgal.”

paite: Samuel in, "TOUPA'N TOUPA thu zuih makipahpih bang in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate akipahpih a hia? Ngai in, kithoihna sang in thuman ahoihzaw a, belamtal thau sang in athu man ahoihzaw hi.
english: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.

paite: Helna zaw aisan khelhna toh akibang a, engtatna zaw milim biakna toh akikim hi. TOUPA thu na nial ziak in ama'n leng kumpipa ding in nang ahon nialta," achi hi.
english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

paite: Saul in Samuel kiangah, "Mipite lau a, athu uh ka manna lam in TOUPA thupiak leh nang thu ka na bohse maizen a; ka na khialta hi.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in ka khelhna ngaidam inla, TOUPA ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei nawn in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na nialta a, nang lam ah ka hong kihei nawn kei ding. TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in ahon deih kei," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh’s word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel pai dia akiheileh apuan mong ah alen a, akekta hi.
english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in akiang ah, "Tuni a pan ToUPA'N Israel gam ahon sutta, nang sang a hoihzaw na inveng kiang ah apeta hi.
english: Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

paite: Israelte thagui azuau kei dia, akisik sam kei ding. Mihing bang a kisik nawn themthum mi ahi ngal kei hi," achi hi.
english: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, “Ka na khialta hi. Himahleh ka mite upate leh Israelte ma a hon zahtak ding in ka hon ngen hi. TOUPA na Pathian ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei in aw," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in Saul apaipih a, Saul in TOUPA abia hi.
english: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.

paite: Samuel in, "Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi. Samuel kiang ah ling kawm in Agag ava hoh hi. Agag in, "Sihna mulkimhuai in hon paikhengta ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

paite: Samuel in, "Na namsau in numeite ta nei lou dia abawl bang in na nu leng numei lak a ta neiloumi ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah Agag asatzanta hi.
english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.

paite: Huchi in Ramah ah Samuel apai a; Saul bel a-inn ah Saul omna khua Gibeah ah apaitou hi.
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in asih ni pha in Saul amu nawnta kei hi. Samuel bel Saul ziak in alungkham hi. Israelte kumpipa dia Saul ana tel ziak in TOUPA akisik hi.
english: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. Yahweh grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.
